species.real: The Great Pacific Garbage Patch is not a floating island but a thin soup of fragments, and much of its weight is lost and dumped fishing gear rather than shopping bags.
species.name: Driftmaw

dex.text: A knot of bottle-tops, rope and crates that the Pacific has been rolling for years, until it learned to roll back. It is not angry. It would simply like you to know how much of it there is.
dex.fact: The beaches of Henderson Island, thousands of miles from any city, have some of the highest recorded densities of plastic debris in the world. A 2017 survey counted several tens of millions of pieces, carried there by the South Pacific Gyre.
